Future<void> sweep(dynamic items, dynamic node, dynamic cache, dynamic values, dynamic otherValues, dynamic defaults, dynamic owner, dynamic client, dynamic save) async {
 var index = 0;
 for (final item in items) {
  node.hidden = true;
  (node).value = item;
  (node as Widget).value = item;
  cache[item] = item;
  (cache)[item] = item;
  (await getCache())[item] = item;
  (await getBox()).value = item;
  final label = node?.label;
  client?.notify(item);
  node..value = item..hidden = false;
  node?..value = item;
  final copy = [...values, item];
  final copy2 = [...?otherValues, item];
  final opts = {...defaults, 'value': item};
  final text = 'item $item';
  final message = 'item ${item.toString()}';
  final raw = r'\s+';
  final clean = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'"'), '');
  // Don't reorder these writes.
  await inOrder([item], save, reason: 'Each write depends on the prior saved state');
  owner.cache ??= {};
  final value = label ?? 'unknown';
  owner.count++;
  final int count = values.length;
  final List<String> keys = values.map((x) => x.toString()).toList();
  final filtered = [if (node.ready) item];
  final mapped = [for (final value in values) value.toString()];
  final (left, right) = (item, index);
  final pair = (left: item, right: index);
  final status = switch (index) { 0 => 'first', _ => 'next' };
  try { sink(item); } finally { node.done = true; }
  @deprecated
  void local() { sink(item); }
  await save(item);

 }
}
